notes:
Edit the inside of a chip

Looking into a chip showed it but did not let the player change it -
fixing a chip meant building it again from scratch. The inside view
now has 'Edit': the inside becomes a normal board with its own
simulation, and 'Save chip' makes the chip anew wherever it is used;
the board outside lays its wires onto pins that moved. 'Discard' goes
back without changes, the arrow asks when there are some.
